pages.text: The $(item)Shatter Bank$() is a two-block machine admins place at spawn and in safe zones. Right-click it to open your account.$(br2)Your account holds $(l)Shatter Pieces$(), the everyday money. Pieces are never an item: they live in the account, and the same balance follows you to every server of the network.$(br2)Every player is given 500 pieces on their first join.

The bank also keeps $(item)Shatter Coins$() for you, by tier. Coins in the bank are safe from raids but earn $(l)no interest$(): a Coin Vault pays interest and can be robbed. Choose.$(br2)Deposit coins to keep them, or $(l)convert$() them: a Copper coin becomes 1,000 pieces, each higher tier double the one below. Converting is one way. Pieces never turn back into coins.
pages.title: Coins and pieces

pages.text: From the account screen you can pay any player on the network, online or not; large payments ask you to confirm, and you can refuse incoming payments.$(br2)The transaction log lists what you bought and sold, who you paid and who paid you, with filters and a search. It is kept for 90 days.$(br2)Commands are a backup: $(l)/bank$(), $(l)/bank pay$(), $(l)/bank log$().
pages.title: Paying and the log
